checks: An integer vertex translation changes dilation by an integer vector mv. Integer vertex differences span the direction space, so the saturated lattice has rank s and preserves the counts.

The generic interior perturbation assigns each boundary point to exactly one full-dimensional cone. Coordinates closed or open at zero give fundamental intervals [0,1) or (0,1] and unique lattice remainders.

The generating series for each cone has nonnegative numerator coefficients and denominator (1-t)^(s+1). Height zero gives h_0=1 and height one gives h_1=N-s-1. Retaining both terms gives the stated binomial bound for each m≥1.
The exact source §2 agrees with the claim. Independent integer enumerations of simplex dilations and interval counts match the formula.

overlap.comparison: Its finite-set weighted sum estimate gives the linear repeated-sum bound. It does not provide the dimension-sensitive Ehrhart coefficient estimate for the entire lattice dilation.

readability: The reduction to the saturated lattice and the half-open boundary convention are explicit.
review_method: Independent mathematical proof review of the frozen normalized candidate
summary: The two-coefficient dilation bound is proved in the saturated affine lattice, including the singleton case.
